_comment: Single source of truth for PORTING_MATRIX.md and for every deltas/<version>/ patch.
Generated artefacts must not be hand-edited: change this table and run
Fields: java/fabric_loader/loom/neoforge are the pins a delta writes into gradle.properties;
facts.gui_graphics drives the GuiMixin/HUD hunks; facts.options_hijack_range writes
AetheriumMixinPlugin's range for the settings hijack; facts.notes become notes.md.
Values marked derived/unverified in PORTING_MATRIX.md are the table's own honesty about
what could not be read from a real source in the authoring environment.

rows.status_note: pins read from a real upstream project that ships this version toolchain raised to Java 17: common/ uses var, text blocks and switch expressions, so an 8/16 compile target is a source back-port and not a build pin; the jar still loads on a 1.16.5 client running Java 17, which is what Fabric Loader 0.14+ on that version does in practice.

notes: Pre-`GuiGraphics`: `Gui#render` takes a `PoseStack` and `LightTexture` (this is what the legacy hook in GuiMixin covers).
No `DebugScreenOverlay` class: F3 lines come from `Gui#renderDebugOverlayText`, so the F3 append needs the `getDebugLines` candidate already in the list.
Dynamic-light colour depth is limited by `LightTexture#updateTick` writing two 16x16 channels; the lightmap is `NativeImage`.
